purpose: Classify public contracts by whether they actually circulate through the runtime refinery pipeline.
active_contract_rule: A public active contract must have a schema file, a runtime producer or consumer, and a runtime schema-file validation/load path. Contracts that only appear as schema_version strings are declared interfaces, not active pressure-tested pipes.
demotion_rule: A root-level public schema with no runtime file hit, no runtime schema_version hit, and no documented compatibility reason must be moved to private quarantine or a legacy/private-only area before production-ready can be claimed.
